name: Khun Dan Marathon 2026
short_description: Khun Dan Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 18 October 2026 at Khun Dan Prakan Chon Dam in Nakhon Nayok, over 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Khun Dan Marathon 2026 is the seventh edition ("Season 7 - Every Step Has A Story"), held at Khun Dan Prakan Chon Dam in Nakhon Nayok, and the registration page describes a smooth road course. The marathon starts at 03:30 and the half marathon at 05:00; the page gives climbs of about 400 m for the marathon and 390 m for the half. RECRACE SPORT Co., Ltd. handles registration and is the organiser contact.

faqs.question: What are the start times and cut-offs at Khun Dan Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The marathon starts at 03:30 with a 7-hour cut-off, and the half marathon starts at 05:00 with a 4-hour cut-off. The 10 km starts at 05:30 (2 hours 30 minutes), and the 5 km at 05:45 has no time limit.

faqs.question: Is there an age limit or prize money at Khun Dan Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Runners under 18 may not enter the marathon. Overall prize money runs to THB 6,000 for first place in the marathon and THB 4,000 in the half marathon, plus age-group trophies.
